title: Activities of U.S. Affiliates of Foreign Multinational Enterprises in 2012
主要内容: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis (BEA) released preliminary statistics on U.S. affiliates of foreign multinational enterprises (MNEs) in 2012. These statistics, based on the 2012 Benchmark Survey of Foreign Direct Investment in the United States, cover financial and operational details of U.S. affiliates, including balance sheet, income statement, employment, employee compensation, capital expenditures, trade in goods, and research and development spending. The data focuses on majority-owned U.S. affiliates. The current-dollar value added of majority-owned U.S. affiliates totaled $773.8 billion in 2012, a 3.7 percent increase from the previous year. However, the growth rate was slower than the value added of all U.S. private industry, leading to a decrease in affiliates’ share of U.S. private industry value added from 6.2 percent in 2011 to 6.1 percent in 2012. U.S. affiliates employed 5.8 million workers in 2012, an increase of 1.3 percent. Exports of goods by affiliates rose 5 percent, while imports of goods by affiliates rose 4 percent. About 60 percent of the goods imported by affiliates were intended for resale without further processing. Research and development (R&D) performed by affiliates rose 6 percent.
